d:
The Nuggets defeated the Grizzlies, 123-118 tonight in Memphis. Jamal Murray finished with a team-high 30 points along with 8 assists and 4 rebounds for the Nuggets, while Nikola Jokić tallied 27 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists in the game. Ty Jerome recorded 22 points, 5 assists and 2 rebounds. The Nuggets improve their record to 6-4 with the win, while the Grizzlies fall to 7-4 for the season.
